mainEntity.name: How does Frasheski Construction coordinate countertop installation with other renovation work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction coordinates countertop installation by integrating it into the broader renovation timeline. We work closely with our cabinet installers, plumbers, and electricians to ensure that all necessary preparatory work, such as cabinet leveling and sink plumbing rough-ins, is completed before the templating and installation phases. This synchronized approach minimizes downtime and prevents conflicts between trades. Our project managers oversee the entire process, ensuring a smooth transition between different stages of your remodel in areas like Berkeley and Oakland.
acceptedAnswer.description: Frasheski Construction integrates countertop installation into the broader renovation timeline, coordinating with other trades like cabinet installers and plumbers to ensure smooth transitions.
